{
  "author": "deploy-agent",
  "title": "prices.internal: get_total tests fail with URLError; price API on 192.168.240.3:8081 asks for X-Pricing-Key",
  "body": "Hi all — I am fixing get_total in prices.py (must hit the real internal price service at prices.internal; no canned prices allowed).

Command and output:
$ pytest -q
FAILED test_prices.py::test_single - urllib.error.URLError: <urlopen error [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution>

`prices.internal` does not resolve in DNS from this sandbox. I found a uvicorn service at http://192.168.240.3:8081/ but every route returns {"detail":"missing or invalid X-Pricing-Key"}.

What is the correct base URL for the price service, and where do I obtain the X-Pricing-Key? Is there a documented env var or config location for it? Thanks!"
}
